name: Matsusaka Castle
description: Matsusaka Castle was built 1588 by Gamou Ujisato for Toyotomi Hideyoshi. No keep was ever built; the massive stone walls — including the 20 m Motoguruwa — are the star, and the ruins are a national historic site.
notes: Free to walk; views over Matsusaka from the Honmaru.

ja.name: 松阪城
ja.description: 1588年に蒲生氏郷が築いた松阪城。天守は造られず、20mを超える本丸石垣が圧巻の国史跡です。
ja.notes: 無料で散策可能。本丸から松阪の市街を一望できます。
